name: Rising Causeway
description: An original first-person 3D stone chamber uses fixed staged wall tiles, a directional triple staircase, and contact launchers to open a route to a far terminal.
natural_language: Read the rising chamber in 3D. Set the red extrusion, select the stair end that raises the far ledge, prime the correctly oriented blue launcher, ride its contact launch, and activate the terminal.

metadata.variant_count_kind: seeded palette, chamber roll, actuator gallery, five controlled difficulty profiles, and two input surfaces
metadata.notes: The browser and independent grader use the same generated chamber geometry, actuator stages, stair heights, contact-launch path, and terminal tolerance. The hidden required choices are retained for replay and the scripted oracle, not rendered as instructions. Live and paused observation frames show action-triggered movement and launch settling, but no correct action expires solely during inference.
